foot_about: A language school born in São Paulo. English first, more languages next.
foot_credit: Pattern inspired by the São Paulo sidewalk designed by Mirthes Bernardes (1966). Our visual inspiration also comes from the Modern Art Week (Theatro Municipal de São Paulo, February 1922) and Brazilian modernism: the geometry and colours of Anita Malfatti, Di Cavalcanti and Tarsila do Amaral and the idea of cultural anthropophagy. These are references to the movement; there is no link to the artists or their heirs.
foot_chars: Sophia, Erick and Teacher Lili are SPLA's illustrated characters. Sophia is an AI tutor.
